adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, the `loadUsers` rewrite changes the Prisma `select` for the `findMany` branch and removes the previously-selected `organization: { select: { slug: true } }` entirely. It also introduces a broad `try/catch` that converts non-`HttpError`/non-Prisma-known errors into a generic `HttpError` 500 (`"Unable to load users"`), which can obscure underlying failures. While the diff doesn’t show downstream usage proving a definite runtime break, this is real, diff-grounded behavioral/API-shape churn that increases regression surface and reduces error specificity.
